message.content:
The answer to “what is the best movie in 2020?” depends on how you define “best.” Below are a few ways to look at it—critical consensus, audience reception, and award recognition—along with the movies that topped each category. | Category | Criteria | Top‑rated 2020 Movies (with key metrics) | |----------|----------|----------------------------------------| | **Critical consensus (Rotten Tomatoes)** | Tomatometer score (percentage of positive reviews) | 1. *The Trial of the Chicago 7* – 94%
2. *The Irishman* – 88%
3. *The Invisible Man* – 86%
4. *The Gentlemen* – 84%
5. *The Last Duel* – 80% | | **Audience reception (IMDb)** | IMDb rating (out of 10) | 1. *The Irishman* – 8.4
2. *The Trial of the Chicago 7* – 8.1
3. *The Invisible Man* – 7.6
4. *The Midnight Sky* – 7.4
5. *The King of Staten Island* – 7.3 | | **Box‑office performance** | Domestic gross (USD) | 1. *The Irishman* – $12 M
2. *The Trial of the Chicago 7* – $5 M
3. *The Invisible Man* – $4 M
4. *The Midnight Sky* – $3 M
5. *The King of Staten Island* – $2 M | | **Major awards (Oscars, BAFTA, etc.)** | Wins & nominations | • *Parasite* (2019 film, but won Best Picture at the 92nd Oscars held in 2020)
• *The Trial of the Chicago 7* – 3 Oscar nominations (Best Picture, Best Original Screenplay, Best Supporting Actor)
• *The Irishman* – 3 Oscar nominations (Best Picture, Best Supporting Actor, Best Film Editing)
• *The Invisible Man* – 1 Oscar nomination (Best Visual Effects) | ### Take‑away - **If you’re looking for the most critically lauded film of 2020,** *The Trial of the Chicago 7* tops the Rotten Tomatoes list with a 94 % score. - **If you want the film that resonated most with general audiences,** *The Irishman* has the highest IMDb rating among 2020 releases. - **If you’re interested in award recognition,** *Parasite* remains the standout, having won Best Picture at the Oscars held in 2020, even though it premiered in 2019. Among pure 2020 releases, *The Trial of the Chicago 7* and *The Irishman* received the most Oscar nods. Ultimately, “the best” movie is a matter of personal preference and the specific criteria you value most.
